integrity: All two-map successors recomputed exactly by integer arithmetic on 15,361 states, with a separately implemented numerical check; independent mathematical audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite-state result for binary16 round-to-nearest-even, explicitly specified expression trees and nonnegative domain [0,1]; no extension to other precisions, hardware compiler semantics or continuous dynamics. Public date from the November 8, 2022 posted preprint cover, reproduced in a public full-text record; the DOI landing page was inaccessible. Unindexed identical tables remain possible.
title: Two exact binary16 logistic cycle spectra under algebraically equivalent evaluation
